create_llff_dataset: create a LLFFDataset instance from a config to load poses, bounds, and images for training or validation
create_dense_llff_dataset: create a DenseLLFFDataset instance to load grid-arranged poses and images with row and column skip logic
review_llff_read_meta: review the LLFFDataset read_meta method that loads poses_bounds.npy, computes intrinsics, and splits train and validation sets
review_dense_llff_read_meta: review the DenseLLFFDataset read_meta method that loads separate bounds.npy and poses.npy files with grid-based train/val splitting
summarize_llff_ray_methods: summarize the LLFFDataset get_rays, get_rgb, to_ndc, and get_intrinsics methods for ray casting and image loading
